description: Na₃Sc₂(BO₃)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.85 Å. Sc is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted face-sharing ScO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.03 Å) and three longer (2.21 Å) Sc-O bond lengths. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.38 Å) and one longer (1.39 Å) B-O bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na, one Sc, and one B atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sc, and one B atom to form distorted face-sharing ONa₂Sc₂B trigonal bipyramids.
